(async () => { const fine = Date.now() + 3000; for (;;) { const s = document.querySelector('[data-sezione=cosa-ha-fatto]'); if (s) { s.scrollIntoView(); return true } if (Date.now() > fine) return false; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100)) } })()
